The metadata and focused lifecycle test are in place. I’m running the config package tests with module downloads disabled.

item.text:
Updated Ubuntu lifecycle data: 20.04 has extended support through April 1, 2030, and 22.04 is recognized with standard support through April 1, 2027 and extended support through April 1, 2032. Added date and boundary checks in [os_test.go](/app/config/os_test.go).

The `config` and `models` tests passed with downloads disabled. The repository issue is resolved.
